name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Curvion builds what I've been building for my own clients: CRM, automation, and AI layered onto a real sales process. Through Solenzo I run discovery with owners and sales teams, recommend the system, and build it in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, including a 20+ workflow engine that handles lead capture, routing, qualification, booking, and reactivation. I want to do that across more clients and bigger engagements, with a delivery team behind me.

The bridge between sales and delivery is where I've spent my career. At Accelo I sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management implementations for agencies and professional-services firms, ranked top three on the team while quota roughly doubled, and built the implementation plans the delivery team executed. I know what happens when a deal gets sold without a realistic scope, because I was the one handing it over.
I also carried a quota for most of a decade, so I understand how sales teams actually operate, not just how the CRM is configured. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
